title: Act: Add playSceneTransition engine helper
summary: Create the helper that reads the transition entry and calls playTransition.
description: Add game/src/engine/playSceneTransition.ts exporting playSceneTransition(ctx, scene) that calls ctx.playTransition with the durationMs of the first transition effect.
acceptance_criteria: playSceneTransition calls ctx.playTransition(durationMs) for a scene with a transition spec.
playSceneTransition makes no call when no transition spec exists.

steps.action: Create the file exporting playSceneTransition(ctx: EffectRenderContext, scene: SceneDef): void that finds the first entry of scene.effects with type 'transition' and calls ctx.playTransition(spec.durationMs); returns without calling when none is found.
